description: Find code quality issues: TODO/FIXME comments, deprecated symbols, structural code patterns (bare except:, print() calls). Use for project-wide audits.

check.description: What to check: "pattern" (structural search via ast-grep, e.g. "except:", "print($$$ARGS)"), "todo" (TODO/FIXME comments), "deprecated" (deprecated symbols), "annotations" (find by decorator name), "all" (todo + deprecated summary)

pattern.description: Code pattern for check="pattern". ast-grep syntax: "except:" finds bare excepts, "print($$$ARGS)" finds print calls.

name: code_audit
